name: VPS Settings
author: Brett
description: View and change the settings the VPS itself enforces (vps-settings@1, framework/cli/vps-settings.mjs), starting with the orchestrator-only rule: a headless Claude build launch without the orchestrator dispatcher's token is refused, logged and noticed on the phone. Settings → Plugins → VPS Settings: the rule on/off (off is Brett's own click), phone notices, notice spacing, log size, and the refused-jobs log with Refresh and Clear. Every action is a REST route, so MCP, the CLI and voice reach it too.
